name: Slack Notify MCP
description: MCP server for posting messages to Slack channels via webhooks or bot API. Supports configurable usernames, emojis, and both webhook and bot token authentication modes.

rawRecord.description: MCP server for posting messages to Slack channels via webhooks or bot API. Supports configurable usernames, emojis, and both webhook and bot token authentication modes.

CHANNEL.description: Default channel (name for webhook mode like '#general', ID for bot mode like 'CXXXXXXXXXX')

BOT_TOKEN.description: Slack bot token (required for bot mode, starts with xoxb-)

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Slack webhook URL (required for webhook mode)
